Host Cascade Integration (@layer picotol): For applications using CSS @layer, import the layered build to guarantee seamless token overriding without specificity conflicts:

@layer host, picotol, overrides;
@import "@kidthales/picotol/layer";

How to read contrast ratios: Luminance contrast ranges from 1:1 (invisible) to 21:1 (pure black on white). ✓ AAA (≥ 7.0:1) is the highest W3C tier (enhanced low-vision legibility); ✓ AA (≥ 4.5:1) is the standard pass threshold for normal body text and UI controls.

2. Concurrent Subtree Theming

Picotol provides container-level [data-accent] scoping without color-scheme leakage. Multiple distinct accent trees run concurrently side-by-side in isolated container scopes with distinct buttons, switches, badges, and progress indicators.

3. Typography & Inline Semantics

Body copy uses the system font stack with fluid root sizing via clamp(100%, 95% + 0.4vw, 125%) and an opt-in 75ch reading measure via :where(.measure, .prose). Links like primary link, secondary link, contrast link, and external link (opens in a new tab) step along Paul Tol's qualitative lightness ladder on hover.

Inline elements include strong, emphasis, highlighted mark, inserted text, deleted text, inline code, Ctrl + K, and PTCS (hover or focus for tooltip).

"The contrast ratio between each colour in the dark scheme and white is at least 4.5 for people with moderately low vision."
— Paul Tol, SRON Notes on Colour Schemes

Unordered List

  • Qualitative schemes: Bright, High-Contrast, Vibrant, Muted
  • Cell-highlight schemes: Pale and Light
  • Text & line scheme: Dark

Preformatted Code

:root {
  color-scheme: light dark;
  --pt-bg: light-dark(var(--tol-white), var(--tol-black));
}

6. Semantic Data Tables & Operational Monitor

Data tables feature automatic tabular numeric alignment, alternating zebra stripes via table.striped, status dot indicators, and horizontal scrolling via responsive figure:has(> table) and .overflow-auto.

Table Container Utility (.overflow-auto / .table-container)

Multi-column wide tabular datasets wrapped in .overflow-auto or .table-container maintain localized horizontal scrolling without window blowouts:
